groups.title: SLI and SLO Design
groups.question: Walk through how you would define reliability targets for a user-facing service.

followUps.Choosing Meaningful SLIs: Why can a metric like CPU usage look healthy while users are having a bad time?
followUps.SLO Target Setting: What goes wrong when an SLO target is set too high or too low, and who should agree on it?

groups.title: Error Budget Policy
groups.question: Explain what an error budget is and how teams use it to make decisions.

followUps.Error Budget Calculation: How do you turn an SLO into an error budget, and how should a team react when it burns too fast?
followUps.Multi-Window Burn Rate Alerts: Why does a single threshold on budget burn miss problems, and how do multiple windows fix that?

groups.title: SLO as Code with Sloth
groups.question: Explain how you can manage SLOs as code and show them to the people who care about them.

followUps.Sloth SLO Definitions: What does a tool like Sloth generate for you from a short SLO file, and why keep that file in Git?
followUps.SLO Dashboards in Grafana: What should an SLO dashboard show so that both engineers and non-technical people can use it?

groups.title: SLO Culture and Process
groups.question: Explain how SLOs become part of how an organization works, not just numbers on a screen.

followUps.SLO Review Cadence: What should happen in a regular SLO review, and why does it matter for planning?
